title: PrimeAI
summary: An AI document processing platform where business teams create their own extraction models, annotate the fields they need, and push the results straight into their workflows. I led the frontend and built role- and group-based access control from the ground up so teams with strict data rules could adopt it.

title: ContextDesk Lab
summary: A support chat built to take Redis Iris apart: every request returns an answer and, beside it, the record of how that answer was made — which memories and records reached the model, what was left out and why, and what each step cost. It exists to put a number on what a semantic cache is worth, so a question asked again in other words comes back from LangCache with the model never called.

outcomes.label: A rephrased question answered from cache, against 4.65s through the model
Tokens billed on that answer, down from 576
Similarity the rephrasing matched at, against a 0.92 threshold

title: QueueLens
summary: A job queue where FastAPI accepts work, Redis hands it to a background worker, and PostgreSQL records every job's state so nothing is lost across restarts. A Next.js dashboard shows each job moving through the queue, including failed attempts that retry with exponential backoff.

outcomes.label: Attempts per job, backing off 2s then 4s
Jobs per client every 10 seconds before a 429
Waiting jobs before the API sheds load

title: Retrieval pipeline for 100+ page documents
summary: A pipeline that turns unstructured PDFs into JSON matching a schema the user defines, running entirely on local infrastructure so nothing sensitive leaves the environment. Text and tables live in separate vector stores, chunked along the document structure and reranked by a cross-encoder.

outcomes.label: Better retrieval precision than a single-store baseline
